title: Yes, That IS a Hallmark Star on Your Tequila Bottle: Inside Andrew Walker’s Unique Partnership (EXCLUSIVE)
body_markdown:
The one place you might not expect to find your favorite Hallmark star? On a bottle of tequila. But in 2025, that is, indeed, one of the places you’ll find Hallmark fan-favorite **Andrew Walker** : with a sketch of his face on limited-edition bottles of SWŌL tequila.


## Only 300 Andrew Walker Holiday Tequila Bottles From SWŌL Are Available


> View this post on Instagram
>
>
> [A post shared by SWŌL Tequila (@swoltequila)](https://www.instagram.com/p/DRGdrcoEUhp/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loading)


SWŌL, a premium tequila brand from Mexico known for releasing small batches of its recipes, has partnered with Walker on a very limited release of 300 “Andrew Walker Happy Holidays” bottles of tequila, which its website boasts as being “made for cozy movie nights, festive cheers, and Hallmark-level magic.”


Each 750 milliliter bottle costs $114.99 and can only be purchased online, with 200 available in the U.S. and 100 available in Canada. SWŌL is now accepting pre-orders and states on its website that “when they’re gone, they’re gone.”


While the partnership may come as a surprise to some, Walker says it’s a perfect fit, explaining to EntertainmentNow, “I’m a tequila guy. I’m an Anejo guy specifically, which is an aged process they put the tequila through in oak barrels.”


## Andrew Walker’s Tequila Labels Can Be Repurposed


When SWŌL reached out to Walker, he loved the idea of a partnership, explaining, “They said, ‘Look, we have these labels that we are looking to partner with people at certain times of the year, and because you’re kind of the king of Christmas, we want to see if you’d like to do a label, our first ever Christmas label.”


The festive and quirky label, with a sketch of Walker wearing a green Santa hat, is actually a collector’s Holiday Patch that can be peeled off the bottle and attached to a favorite piece of clothing.


Walker said, “We came up with this label together, designed it together, and I’m really proud of it. I love the product. I don’t drink rum or whiskey, or really anything else. I drink tequila, and specifically this type. This is the only tequila they do.”


## Andrew Walker Brought His Tequila on the Hallmark Christmas Cruise & Says His Colleagues Loved It


When the **“Three Wisest Men”** star was among 18 stars aboard the Hallmark Christmas Cruise in early November, he brought eight bottles of his tequila to share with his colleagues and their friends or family members.


“Honestly, we went through all eight bottles,” Walker laughed. “People freaked out about the tequila we had. We had other options (on the ship), but everyone went through the SWŌL before they went through all the other stuff.”


Walker, whose next Christmas movie, **“She’s Making a List”** with Lacey Chabert, premieres on December 6, added, “It’s got, like, vanilla notes to it. You can just do it over ice, you don’t need to mix it with anything. I like to do it over ice with a little orange slice in there, super clean. You have one of those, it’s nice — you don’t have a hangover in the morning. It’s just a very classy cocktail.”
